hook.name: NavJitHook
hook.description: A JIT (just-in-time) liquidity hook for basket token pools that prices swaps at NAV ± spread. On each swap it lifts standing liquidity, mints or redeems basket constituents on-chain to supply inventory, places a narrow JIT position, then removes it after the swap while enforcing a price-band constraint. Third-party liquidity additions are blocked; only the owner seeds the standing position.
